Кордицепс.about: TCM fungus: CKD has lower creatinine/proteinuria; Metabolism is better after transplantation.
Кордицепс.caution: Cordyceps sinensis is a mushroom from traditional Chinese medicine. For CKD: 2 Cochrane reviews (25519252, 26457607) show improvement in renal function as an adjuvant to standard therapy. For kidney transplant recipients: data available. For endurance: limited data (individual RCTs, not systematically compiled). For pulmonary diseases: limited data. Expensive drug, often counterfeited.
effects: VO2: weak in the elderly, none in athletes
Кордицепс.food_sources: Not food: mushroom, TCM raw materials; the drug is expensive and often counterfeited - there is no food source.
Кордицепс.guidelines: 2024 MA (lung cancer): adjuvant - QoL better; 2024 MA (COPD, Bailing): lung function is higher. Standardization of form is critical.
Кордицепс.how_to_choose: 1-3 g/day of standardized mushroom, with quality control; for CKD/transplantation - only with a doctor.
mechs: VO2: weak in the elderly, none in athletes
Reduction of creatinine and proteinuria in CKD (not on dialysis)
CKD: creatinine −61 µmol/l, clearance +9.2; RCT quality is poor
Adjuvant to immunosuppression after kidney transplantation
Rejection = azathioprine, but nephrotoxicity and metabolism are better (2017)
Кордицепс.myths: “Sports ergogenics” - RCTs for endurance are single, not systematized. “It will cure the kidneys on its own” - only an adjuvant, the quality of RCT is weak.
Кордицепс.name: Cordyceps
Кордицепс.onset: Coursework: markers are better during CKD therapy; after transplantation the effect is 6-12 months.
Кордицепс.title: Cordyceps
Кордицепс.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Кордицепс.who_needs: CKD without dialysis (adjuvant, with a doctor); kidney transplant recipients (not in place of immunosuppression); sport is not justified.
